name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: Routine ash advisories; no red codes (26 Nov)
summary: Routine ash advisories on 26 Nov for volcanoes in Chile, the Philippines and Indonesia; no red codes or closures
state: Volcanic ash advisories on 26 Nov covered Nevados de Chillán in Chile, with a thin plume to FL120, an eruption at Kanlaon in the Philippines to about FL090, and Karangetang, Ibu, Semeru and Dukono in Indonesia (Bureau of Meteorology). None was found carrying a red aviation colour code. No VEI 4+ eruption or major ash-related airspace closure was found by 26 Nov, so Normal holds.
for_you: Air travellers in Indonesia and the Philippines may see occasional local delays; check with airlines if flying near active volcanoes.
rubric_hit: No aviation colour code red and no large eruption = Normal

sources.title: Bureau of Meteorology — Volcanic ash advisories received in last 7 days

why: Major eruptions ground flights (Iceland 2010) and can cool the climate for years.
drivers: Volcanic unrest; impact depends on ash plume height and jet-stream direction.

rubric.alert: Major airspace closures from ash, or a VEI 4+ eruption.
rubric.watch: Aviation colour code orange/red at a volcano near major air routes, or a large eruption.
rubric.normal: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
